why: Returns earned state to living only in the `--earned` class, so an earned row and a locked row are announced identically and the single fact the Records pane exists to report is the one thing a screen reader cannot get. The span survives, so a structural check for `.ui-sr-only` still passes -- the assertion has to read its CONTENT, and does. COUNT RE-MEASURED for issue #630, 1 -> 2 of 23 in hud.a11y.test.ts: #630 made the state word visible and added 'shows earned or locked as a visible word, not only a dimming and a border hue (issue #630)', which also fails when the word is emptied. The pre-existing failure, 'says earned or locked in words, not only in a class', is unchanged.
